features.catalog_publication: Complete eligible local records publish before semantic and association enrichment; retrieval is not suitability verification.
features.workspace: Stable keyed current cards, claim-scoped verdicts, exact printed source hashes, correction history, bounded retained artifacts and pinning.
features.progressive_review: At most two local batches plus a final combined review. Closed draw/cost fact forms only; ambiguous and strategic prose stays global. Exact original claim IDs, spans, hashes and source indices survive every job.
features.steering: Acknowledged idempotent pin/exclude/prioritize/message operations. Material changes create a generation; old findings supersede and stale writes are fenced.
features.durability: SQLite jobs, leases, heartbeats, snapshots and checkpoints. Queued jobs drain on assistant requests and worker completion. Interrupted running work requires explicit retry; no automatic paid-call replay.

limits: Local review deliberately supports recognized draw/cost facts, not broad strategic local assessments. Generated free prose can fall back to one global review.
Calls sharing a cost ledger serialize through accounting. The recorded-spend ceiling can be crossed by one admitted call; there is no projected-spend guarantee.
Concurrency and cost admission are process-local; the current deployment uses one application process.
In-flight provider transport cannot be interrupted. Ledger waiters and retries check cancellation; paid responses remain accounted and stale publications are rejected.
Restart recovery of interrupted work requires explicit user retry. Queued dispatch is request/worker driven, not an autonomous external job service.
Synthetic tests and one bounded QA probe do not establish production latency percentiles or improved recommendation quality.
